name: deep_moog_bass
description: A deep, round mono bass that slides between notes. Measured from a melodic-techno reference track (numbers only): almost all fundamental, a steep roll-off, mono, slides of about a quarter of a second, steady pitch. The harmonic levels come from a full mix, so their tolerances are wide; the mix's spectral tilt is not the bass's, so it is not a criterion.
